name: io.github.sepehr071/varzesh3-mcp
title: Varzesh3 Sports
description: Read-only Varzesh3 (varzesh3.com) Iranian sports: live scores, tables, fixtures, teams, news.

environmentVariables.name: VARZESH3_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Varzesh3 requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
